# Building

> Building is the UK's leading architecture and construction industry publication, offering digital editions, subscriptions, and news coverage on sustainability, market developments, and professional standards.

Building.co.uk serves the construction and architecture sectors with comprehensive industry news, digital magazine access, and subscription services. The platform covers critical topics including net-zero sustainability initiatives, professional body developments, and construction market trends.

## Subscriptions & Access

- [Subscribe](https://subs.building.co.uk/subscribe): Subscription options for building.co.uk digital access, print delivery, and newsletters
- [Digital Editions](https://www.building.co.uk/home/digital-editions): Digital editions and archive of Building magazine's latest architecture and construction issues

## Industry News & Trends

- [Race to Net Zero](https://www.building.co.uk/news/trending/race-to-net-zero): Construction industry news on net-zero sustainability and energy-efficient building projects
- [RICS in Crisis](https://www.building.co.uk/news/trending/rics-in-crisis): Industry news on RICS professional body crisis and construction market developments
